summary: Named capability and rank ledger with idempotent unlocks, frozen observations and consumer-owned effects.
useWhen: A game needs durable named unlocks that gate traversal, combat, crafting or narrative options without embedding the effects in the ledger.
limitations: Unlocks are session state unless the consumer persists them. Definitions and effect policy remain consumer-owned.
No dependency graph, prerequisites, costs or automatic rewards; the consumer decides when to call unlock.
